ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which organism is the primary producer?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The left side of the picture is labeled Spartina, drawn as a grass-like plant; the other labeled organisms include Prokelisia, Pardosa, Grammonota, Tytthus and Hogna, drawn as animals such as insects or spiders. Arrows point from Spartina to organisms in the animal food web. Reasoning: primary producer refers to a producer that can carry out photosynthesis and is located at the base of the food web, usually a plant. The only plant in the picture is Spartina, so the primary producer is Spartina.
